evals.destination: GitLab merge request comment in group/project
evals.prompt: Rewrite for a GitLab MR comment in group/project: Review merge request !123 at the verified URL https://gitlab.example.com/group/project/-/merge_requests/123. Return only the comment.
expectations: Uses the native clickable !123 reference
Does not append or expose the raw URL
Does not add a second link or a Needs from you section
Does not change the merge request identifier

evals.prompt: Rewrite for raw Slack mrkdwn: Review merge request !123 at the verified URL https://gitlab.example.com/group/project/-/merge_requests/123. Return only the message.
expectations: Uses Slack <url|label> syntax
Uses MR !123 as the readable label
Does not show the URL outside the named link

evals.prompt: Rewrite for Markdown: Jenkins job payments-deploy build 482 passed. Verified build URL: https://ci.example.com/job/payments-deploy/482/. Return only the update.
expectations: Links the useful job and build label
Preserves the observed passed result
Does not emit a label followed by a bare URL

evals.prompt: Rewrite for Markdown: Use the rollback runbook: https://docs.example.com/runbooks/rollback. Return only the sentence.
expectations: Places the verified URL behind the descriptive label
Does not retain the label-colon-URL form

evals.prompt: Rewrite for Markdown: See the checkout dashboard at https://metrics.example.com/d/checkout. The checkout dashboard shows an error rate of 2.1%. Return only the update.
evals.expected_output: The [checkout dashboard](https://metrics.example.com/d/checkout) shows an error rate of 2.1%.
expectations: Links the resource at its first useful mention
Uses the verified URL once
Preserves the measured error rate

evals.prompt: Rewrite for Markdown: Deployment status is in Jenkins build #482. No build URL or job name is available. Return only the update.
evals.expected_output: Deployment status is in Jenkins build #482.
expectations: Keeps the exact bare identifier
Does not add a Needs from you section for optional link metadata
Does not invent a Jenkins host, job path, or URL

evals.destination: Plain-text pager message with no hyperlink syntax
evals.prompt: Rewrite for a plain-text pager that does not support named links: On-call dashboard: https://metrics.example.com/d/on-call. Return only the message.
expectations: Keeps the useful label and raw URL
Does not emit Markdown or Slack link syntax
